hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE '[^[:alnum:]]git[[:space:]]+push([^[:alnum:]]|$)'; then ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -d "$ROOT/.github/workflows" ] || [ -f "$ROOT/.gitlab-ci.yml" ]; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"This repo has CI workflows and a git push is about to run. Validate them locally with the wrkflw skill (wrkflw validate) before pushing."}}'; fi; fi
hooks.description: Remind to validate workflows with wrkflw before git push
